p.title: v59.69 reaction-read.js regexes carried literal backspace bytes instead of \b
p.symptom: Push CI for v59.69 (67b740e5) failed preflight workflow-yaml: 'src/domain/briefing/reaction-read.js: 제어문자 10건'. With no green full-push CI, every later reduced-scope data commit (797ac874, 1da80799) could not be attested, so the live site stayed at v59.68 and its data stopped converging.
p.root_cause: The file was written through a Node/shell heredoc that turned \b into U+0008 (the known heredoc-backslash hazard). The control-character gate runs in CI preflight only, after the commit was pushed. The regexes for CEO/CFO, lowered/cut and raised then matched a backspace instead of a word boundary, so those English cues never matched.
p.fix: The 10 U+0008 bytes are \b again (String.raw replacement); node --check and ci-control-char-check pass.
p.violated_rule: Edit tool, not shell heredocs, for JS with backslashes (CLAUDE.md Windows note)
p.prevention: ci-control-char-check.mjs already fails this; it is in the preflight group, so running qa-runner affected before a push catches it.

changelog: **Earnings reaction cues match again (v59.70, {P}):** ten word-boundary marks in reaction-read.js had been saved as control characters, which kept v59.69 off the live site.
